headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool, Arsenal, Man City in race for Feyenoord defender
description: Liverpool are monitoring Feyenoord right back Givairo Read, but face competition from Arsenal and Manchester City. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Benjamin Šeško vows to 'fully dedicate' himself to recovery after Man United injury setback
description: Manchester United striker Benjamin Sesko has vowed to "fully dedicate" himself to his recovery from an ongoing shin issue.

headline: Kylian Mbappé on past Liverpool transfer talks: 'Mum went to Anfield and fell in love'
description: Kylian Mbappé has described how his mother "fell in love" with Anfield and was keen for him to sign for Liverpool before he decided to join PSG.

headline: Man United-linked Lewis Hall: 'No-brainer' to stay at Newcastle
description: Lewis Hall has said it was a "no-brainer" to sign a new contract to extend his Newcastle United stay after summer transfer interest from Manchester United.

headline: Wayne Rooney: 'Disappointing' if 'top player' JJ Gabriel leaves Man United
description: Wayne Rooney has said it would be "disappointing" for Manchester United to lose "special talent" JJ Gabriel.

headline: Lacroix: We watched Zidane on TV, now we can train with him 1 Like reaction.
